description: This file manages event types, specifically handling creation, updating, deletion, and linking of child event types within a managed event system. It includes functions for sending notification emails, checking existing event types, connecting users to event types, and synchronizing settings like CalVideoSettings.

methods.name: sendAllSlugReplacementEmails
methods.description: Sends email notifications to a list of persons with a specific slug and team name.

methods.name: checkExistentEventTypes
methods.description: Checks for existing event types with the same slug for specified users and deletes them if found, then sends notification emails.

methods.name: connectUsersToEventTypesQueryWithParams
methods.description: Builds a parameterized SQL query to connect users to event types in bulk.

methods.name: handleChildrenEventTypes
methods.description: Main function that manages creation, updating, deletion, and linking of child event types based on provided data and settings.
